disqualifier.note: Independent per-asset onError latches on the leftover cluster in LinkPreviewState. Favicon and preview image can each fail alone; writers flip one field at a time and readers AND each flag with its URL independently.

allFit is an OR of unmeasured-or-width-fits used to skip overflow before layout settles. AND/OR combination is not exclusivity; treating unmeasured as fit is a measurement policy over free observations.
settled is a same-scope complement alias of pending (!pending), not a stored parallel flag. The AsyncResult projection is already inventoried as pending/failed.

Layered CSS sanitizer predicates: layout-offset/position checks vs root style allowlist. isSafeMermaidInlineStyle ANDs/short-circuits free combinations; an unsafe layout and an unsafe root style can coexist.
Helper plus aggregator for local fragment URL targets. Duplicate ids and leftover css url() tokens fail independently; the aggregator ANDs them rather than encoding exclusive sanitizer phases.
Independent axes: clientMountedAtom hydration vs tooltip payload presence. The if ANDs them to skip SSR tooltips; all four combinations are legal.
react-dropzone DropzoneOptions bag. disabled/multiple are already inventoried on UploadBoxDropzoneProps; noClick is a hard-coded SDK toggle at the dropzone driver boundary, not a domain phase.
Independent keyboard facts: command chord vs IME composition. shouldSendFromEnter composes the chord with shift/alt; IME is a separate command path, not a masked send-phase union.
Independent URL classifiers (mailto-shaped vs http(s) parse). isValidUrl ANDs them with length and mailto prefix; a value can fail one check and pass the other.
